title: RPSC School Lecturer PGT Teacher Result 2026
postName: School Lecturer (PGT Teacher) – Rajasthan Education Department

shortDescription: RPSC School Lecturer PGT Teacher Result 2026 – check subject-wise result at rpsc.rajasthan.gov.in.
content:
Rajasthan Public Service Commission (RPSC) has released the School Lecturer (PGT Teacher) Result 2026.

Subject-wise result / marks lists are published on the official RPSC website for candidates who appeared in the School Lecturer examination.

Candidates should

  • Download official subject-wise PDF
  • Verify roll number and marks
  • Prepare documents for verification if shortlisted

Always rely on rpsc.rajasthan.gov.in for authentic result downloads.
